en: strong proponent of something; person behaving tyrannically and despotically in a particular matter
one who holds, but did not generate, a given right; especially, a copyright holder who has inherited the copyright from an author
example: 2009, Marie-Catherine Beuth, “Fronde contre Google dans le livre numérique” (“Opposition to Google in the Digital Book”), in Le Figaro, 2009 August 22	Microsoft, Amazon and Yahoo! join the Open Book Alliance, a coalition opposed to the agreement between the Internet group [Google] and American copyright holders.

en: second-person plural present subjunctive/imperative of avoir
